# CLI

The user never needs to type a command. Run it for them: `node .ai/cli/bin/cli.mjs <command>` (or `engr <command>` when the global command is installed) and show the result as is, plus at most two lines on what it means.

## Commands

| Ask | Command |
|---|---|
| "What can I run?" | show this table |
| "Show the board" | `status` · `status --write` (rewrites `tickets/BOARD.md`) |
| "Can I start cart/02?" | `gate implement --ticket cart/02` |
| "Is cart/02 done?" | `gate deliver --ticket cart/02` |
| "Can I write the spec?" | `gate spec` |
| "Is cart ready to ship?" | `gate release --feature cart` |
| "What is tested?" | `trace --feature cart` · `--write` · `--strict` |
| "Record these test results" | `test-report --junit <path> --feature cart --ticket cart/03 --write` |
| "What did teammates change?" | `drift` · `drift --mark` |
| "Is everything consistent?" | `validate` · `validate --task api` |
| "Is my engr-toolbox out of date?" / "Update it" | `update --check` / `update` (upgrades files; confirm first) |
| "Do my commits reference tickets?" | `check-commits --range origin/main..HEAD` |
| "Set up CI / releases" | `pipeline` (or run `/setup-pipeline` for per-branch steps) |
| "What version would be released?" | `release-version` · `release-notes` |
| "Work the tickets unattended" | `loop --agent "<agent cmd>" --verify "<test cmd>" --dry-run` |
| "Token cost?" | `measure` |

## Discover what is installed

| Ask | Command |
|---|---|
| "What skills do we have?" | `discover skills` (filter: `--search <word>`) |
| "What roles?" / "What workflows?" | `discover roles` · `discover workflows` |
| "Which docs exist and are they filled?" | `discover docs` (shows each doc's status) |
| "What is each folder for?" | `discover structure` |
| "Tell me about tdd" | `discover tdd` (any skill, role or workflow name) |
| "Everything" | `discover` |

Then add one line: which item fits what the user is trying to do, and how to start it (`/name` in Claude Code, ask by name in Codex). For "what should I do next", use `/next` instead.

## Regenerate the AI tool files

`.agents/` is the source; `.claude/`, `.cursor/`, `.github/agents/` and the other tool folders are generated from it.

1. Edit the canonical file in `.agents/`, never the copy in a tool folder.
2. `sync --dry-run` to preview, `sync` to apply (all tools in `engr-toolbox.json`, or `--target claude`), `sync --clean` to remove skills that no longer exist.
3. `sync --check` must exit 0.

Generated files carry a `Generated by engr-toolbox` line. Sync only updates files that have it; **delete that line to own a file** and sync leaves it alone.

## Rules

- Read-only commands (`status`, `gate`, `trace`, `drift`, `validate`, `check-commits`, `discover`, `sync --check`, `pipeline` without `--write`) run straight away.
- Commands that write (`--write`, `drift --mark`, `sync`) are fine during the workflow step that needs them; say what was written.
- `loop` without `--dry-run` starts another agent: show the dry run and get a yes first.
- Installing or upgrading (`init`) needs the package from GitHub: `npx --allow-git=all github:work-w-chrstnrpj/engr-toolbox init --yes`. Confirm first.
